name: Photos API
description: A REST API for registering users, authenticating with JWT, and uploading, searching, viewing, downloading, and deleting photos.

security.description: Obtain an access token by logging in. Send it in the Authorization header on endpoints marked auth: true.

endpoints.description: Create a new account with a unique username and password.

body.password: string; required; at least 8 characters; not blank

endpoints.description: Verify credentials and issue a JWT access token.
List photo metadata, optionally filtering by filename or MIME type. Filters use case-insensitive partial matching.

responses.200: OK — array of photo metadata objects
responses.400: Invalid limit (must be greater than zero)

endpoints.notes: Pagination is not supported: there is no offset, page, or cursor parameter.

endpoints.description: Return information about a photo without returning the original file bytes.
Return the original photo bytes. The response is always an attachment, prompting the browser to download the file.

responses.200: OK — binary file, with Content-Type set from the stored MIME type

responseHeaders.Content-Type: Stored photo MIME type, such as image/jpeg or image/png

endpoints.description: Upload an image and associate it with the authenticated user.

request.validation: Files must be non-empty and pass the server's image-type validation.

responses.413: Upload exceeds the configured maximum size
responses.500: Unexpected error while processing the upload

responseHeaders.Location: URI of the created photo, for example /api/photo/1

endpoints.description: Permanently delete a photo by ID. A valid JWT is required.

responses.204: No Content — deleted successfully; empty response body

errors.username: Username must be between 3 and 100 characters
